daily_reality.summary: Mechanical engineers design, develop, build, and test mechanical and thermal devices including tools, engines, and machines. One of the broadest engineering disciplines, they work across nearly every industry from automotive and aerospace to energy and biomedical.
typical_tasks: Design mechanical systems and components using CAD software
Perform engineering analysis (FEA, CFD, thermal, dynamics)
Develop prototypes and oversee testing programs
Conduct design reviews and failure mode analysis (DFMEA)
Manage product development projects from concept to production
Collaborate with manufacturing on design for manufacturability
Perform root cause analysis on field failures
Ensure designs meet industry codes and standards (ASME, SAE)

deadlines.design_reviews: Gate reviews per product development schedule
deadlines.testing: Weeks to months per test program
deadlines.production_launch: Fixed launch dates driving all milestones

daily_reality.seasonality: Automotive model year cycles. Aerospace program milestones. Consumer product holiday season deadlines.

regulatory.summary: ASME codes and standards govern many mechanical designs. PE licensure available and valued for career advancement (10-15% salary premium). Industry-specific regulations (FAA, FDA, NRC) apply to respective sectors.

key_laws.name: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code
key_laws.description: Standards for pressure equipment design and fabrication

key_laws.name: FDA 21 CFR
key_laws.description: Medical device design and manufacturing regulations

certifications: Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt

regulatory.penalties: PE license required for stamping certain designs. Product liability for design failures. FAA enforcement for aerospace non-compliance.

tools.summary: 3D CAD, FEA, CFD, and engineering analysis software combined with testing equipment for product design and validation.

primary_tools.name: ANSYS / ABAQUS / Nastran
primary_tools.description: FEA for structural, thermal, and dynamic analysis

primary_tools.name: ANSYS Fluent / Star-CCM+
primary_tools.description: CFD for fluid flow and thermal analysis

secondary_tools: Keyence / Zeiss CMM for dimensional inspection
PLM systems (Teamcenter, Windchill) for data management
pain_points: Software licensing costs and compatibility issues
Long simulation run times for complex models
Balancing design innovation with manufacturing constraints

terminology.summary: Broad mechanical engineering terminology spanning design, analysis, thermodynamics, dynamics, and manufacturing.

terms.DFMEA: Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis
terms.tolerance stackup: Cumulative effect of individual part tolerances

career_psychology.summary: One of the most versatile and in-demand engineering disciplines. Median salary $102K with 9% projected growth. PE licensure provides 10-15% salary premium. Three job openings per qualified engineer.
fears: Career stagnation in routine design roles
Keeping technical skills current across broad discipline
motivation: Designing tangible products people use daily
Broad applicability across virtually every industry
Strong job market with 3 openings per qualified engineer
Intellectual challenge of solving complex physical problems
Clear career progression with PE and management tracks
burnout_factors: Tight product development schedules and deadlines
Repetitive design iterations and documentation updates
Travel requirements for manufacturing support and testing
Constant technology evolution requiring ongoing learning

community.summary: ASME is the primary professional society (over 85,000 members). SAE International for automotive/aerospace. Strong industry-academia partnership ecosystem.

associations.name: ASME (American Society of Mechanical Engineers)
associations.description: 85,000+ members, codes and standards, conferences, publications

associations.name: SAE International
associations.description: Automotive and aerospace engineering standards and events

associations.name: AIAA (for aerospace focus)
associations.description: American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics

market.summary: Strong 9% projected growth 2024-2034 adding ~32,100 jobs. Three openings per qualified engineer. Median salary $102K. Growth driven by renewable energy, EVs, aerospace, and advanced manufacturing.
market_trends: Renewable energy and clean technology driving demand
Electric vehicle development requiring new thermal and powertrain designs
Robotics and automation expanding mechanical engineering roles
3 job openings per qualified engineer indicating strong demand
